meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 为 NanoClaw 群组搭一个持久化的 wiki 知识库:创建 wiki/ 与 sources/ 目录、初始 index.md 和 log.md,写入维护用的 SKILL.md,并在群组 CLAUDE.md 里加入 wiki 板块,之后由它持续收录、查询和整理资料。
howto.when: 当你提到 "add wiki"、"wiki"、"knowledge base" 等关键词,或要求给某个 NanoClaw 群组加知识库时触发。

say.text: 给这个群组加一个 wiki 知识库
把 sources/ 里的这几个 PDF 逐个收录进 wiki
say.note: 一次只处理一个文件,做完再进下一个

say.text: 安排每周做一次 wiki 健康检查
say.note: 用 schedule_task 定时跑 lint

howto.what_en: Sets up a persistent wiki knowledge base for a NanoClaw group: creates wiki/ and sources/ folders with index and log files, writes a maintenance SKILL.md, and adds a wiki section to the group CLAUDE.md so the agent keeps it updated.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base" etc., or ask to give a NanoClaw group a knowledge base.

say_en.text: Add a wiki knowledge base to this group
say_en.note: Reads the Wiki pattern and asks what you want to build

say_en.text: Ingest these PDFs from sources/ into the wiki one by one
say_en.note: Finishes each file before starting the next

say_en.text: Schedule a weekly wiki health check
say_en.note: Schedules the lint task via schedule_task
